title: Tomo bought GTA 6 in a store... and got a box with just a code
description: Tomo went to the mall to buy a physical copy of GTA 6, then realised the box only holds a download code.
hook_text:
HE BOUGHT GTA 6 IN STORE...
IT'S JUST A CODE
first_comment: Physical box with just a code inside: worth it for the collection, or pointless? 👇
